property_summary: For every call to transfer, C always reverts if the _tos array is empty (i.e., transfer only succeeds when _tos.length > 0); the mutant that removes the initial require allows a successful return for empty _tos, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Change the initial require to allow empty _tos arrays (remove the length check) so transfer can succeed when _tos.length == 0, returning true instead of reverting.
